what: A party Really Denise and Jenny Go-Getter threw in the basement of the Tunnel; Denise calls it her favourite party with Jenny.
where: The Tunnel basement, 220 Twelfth Avenue (West 27th Street).
when: Late 1980s, the Tunnel-kids years (no exact date given).
hay: Denise found a flower-district shop that sold hay and had bales delivered into the Tunnel basement - 'probably a fire hazard', she says.
zaldy: Zaldy came dressed as a zebra and danced in a cage.
outfit: Denise made herself a bikini out of fur scraps from a West Side furrier - something she says she would never do today because she loves animals.
invite: Stephan Lupino photographed the invitation: Denise and Jenny posed behind a cage they built.
